basics.name: Codie Freeman
basics.summary: Final-year Pharmaceutical Chemistry student graduating June 2027, with 13 months of experience in a GMP-regulated contract research organisation. Proficient in owning technical work from design through to client-issued report under formal review, and in using Python to process and interpret raw scientific data.

work.name: Resolian
work.summary: Industrial placement within a GMP-compliant analytical laboratory supporting R&D and regulated client projects.
highlights: Project Delivery: Executed analytical projects to tight sponsor deadlines, acting as lead analyst across multiple studies and working within teams on larger, multi-analyst programmes.
Method Development: Designed an iGC-SEA flow-rate case study demonstrating up to 50% reduction in run time for larger probes, extending the laboratory's varied-flow-rate capability.
Technical Reporting: Authored 3 multiple time-point stability reports to Ph. Eur. 2.9.19, taking each through QC and technical review and addressing reviewer comments before sponsor issue.
Process Improvement: Identified an underutilised composite-imaging function, replacing four-step manual composition with a single capture, and wrote the instructions and training for 4 analysts.
Data Analysis: Recovered Dorris-Gray and Della Volpe surface energy parameters inaccessible through vendor software, processing raw instrument exports in Python and cross-checking outputs.
Data Integrity & Documentation: Maintained GMP laboratory notebooks, ADF records and audit trails to ALCOA++ standard, with sample logbooks and chain of custody kept current across all projects.

work.name: JD Wetherspoon
work.summary: Operational and people leadership role within a highly regulated, high-throughput hospitality environment.
highlights: Team Leadership: Managed teams of up to 20 staff in a hospitality environment, overseeing onboarding, training and shift operations within a 90+ person team.
Operational Performance: Improved average internal audit scores by 15%, contributing to the site's first full green audit in 10 years across cleanliness, stock, cash and people.
Regulatory Coordination: Held personal licence, ensuring full compliance with licensing laws and leading a regulatory inspection that achieved a 5/5 rating.

education.summary: Degree programme including a foundation year, approved interruption of study, and an industrial placement year.

projects.name: Surface Energy of Sucrose at Reduced Particle Sizes
projects.summary: Characterised surface energy heterogeneity across three sucrose fractions produced by two processing routes, using iGC-SEA with Dorris-Gray and Peak COM analysis, alongside PXRD, SEM and BET surface area.
highlights: Found that processing route governs surface energy character more strongly than particle size alone, with no direct relationship between BET specific surface area and surface energy, contrary to the expected trend.
Presented at the Analytical Research Forum 2026 and subsequently adopted as a Resolian marketing resource.
